key_findings: FGF13/Nav1.7 PPI bidirectionally modulates nociception; inhibitor PW164 is antinociceptive and ligand ZL192 is pronociceptive in an FGF13-dependent manner.
FGF13/Nav1.7 ratio is upregulated in type 2 diabetic neuropathy, and PW164 reduces mechanical hyperalgesia in a T2DN model.
